gaps.explanation: fail takes the to-infinitive: failed to meet.
too + adjective + to-infinitive: too young to stay.

gaps.sentence: It's no use ___ about the weather.
gaps.explanation: it's no use + -ing: no use complaining.

gaps.sentence: Do you fancy ___ to the cinema tonight?
gaps.explanation: fancy + -ing (informal British): Do you fancy going…?

gaps.sentence: It took me ages ___ used to the new keyboard.
gaps.explanation: it takes time + to-infinitive: took me ages to get used to the keyboard.

gaps.sentence: They don't allow ___ in the museum.
gaps.hint: allow + noun / allow sb to do
gaps.explanation: allow + noun/-ing (no personal object): they don't allow photography. With a person: allow visitors to photograph.
bother + -ing (or to-infinitive): don't bother going. Both accepted.
seem/appear take the to-infinitive: seems to know.
